description: This source file defines the LogConsistencyProvider class, which implements the ILogViewAdaptorFactory interface. It is responsible for creating log view adaptors that handle storage of the latest view in primary storage, supporting multi-cluster scenarios with optimistic concurrency. The class also indicates whether storage provider features are used.

classes.name: LogConsistencyProvider
classes.description: A log-consistency provider that stores the latest view in primary storage, supporting multiple clusters with optimistic concurrency control.

methods.name: UsesStorageProvider
methods.description: Property indicating the use of storage provider; always returns true.

methods.name: MakeLogViewAdaptor
methods.description: Creates and returns a new LogViewAdaptor instance for the specified view and log entry types.

calls: new LogViewAdaptor<TView,TEntry>(hostGrain, initialState, grainStorage, grainTypeName, services)
